articles.title: Israel waits for a decision on its next government.
p: Israel held parliamentary elections on October 27, but no political bloc won enough seats to have a majority.
This means that no group can form a government by itself.
Political leaders now need to find partners and try to build a coalition with enough support in the Knesset.
Gadi Eisenkot's opposition bloc received majority backing from lawmakers.
Eisenkot was recommended by 67 members of the Knesset.
Benjamin Netanyahu received recommendations from 46 lawmakers.
These recommendations show how many lawmakers currently support each man as a candidate to form the next government.
President Isaac Herzog has not yet chosen a candidate to try to form a government.
He plans to announce his decision on Sunday, November 8.
Until a new government is formed, Netanyahu will remain caretaker prime minister while the political groups continue their coalition negotiations.
If Herzog chooses Eisenkot, Eisenkot will still need to assemble partners before he can form a government.
Support from lawmakers does not mean that coalition talks will be successful.
The different political groups must reach agreements and work together.
The talks could fail, and this could lead to another election in Israel.

o: The Knesset would choose a president.

articles.title: U.S. employers added more jobs than expected in October.
p: U.S. employers added 165,000 jobs during October, according to the latest employment report.
This result was much stronger than economists had expected.
They had predicted that employers would add approximately 65,000 jobs.
The unemployment rate also declined unexpectedly to 4.1%.
Professional and business services had the largest increase among the sectors listed in the report.
This sector added 70,000 positions.
Healthcare employment increased by 42,000 jobs.
Transportation and warehousing also grew, adding 25,000 positions during the month.
Workers also saw higher pay.
Average hourly earnings rose by 3.1% compared with October 2025.
Earnings are important because they help show whether workers' pay is growing.
However, faster pay growth can also affect prices and decisions about interest rates.
The strong jobs report could complicate possible interest rate cuts by the Federal Reserve.
A strong labor market may reduce the need for lower rates.
However, officials will receive more information before making policy decisions.
October inflation data will arrive on Tuesday and offer additional guidance about the economy.
The Federal Reserve can consider both employment and inflation information when thinking about future rate changes.

close to a number, but not exactly

quiz.q: What happened to the unemployment rate?
quiz.why: The unemployment rate unexpectedly fell to 4.1%.

quiz.why: October inflation data will provide officials with additional guidance about the economy.

articles.title: LIV Golf will wind down its operations after bankruptcy.
p: LIV Golf will wind down its operations following a decision during a bankruptcy-court hearing in New Jersey.
Lawyers abandoned plans to create a revived league called LIV 2.0.
This means the organisation will not continue with the proposed new version of the competition.
An important financial plan also ended when BC Partners withdrew from a proposed $300 million investment.
The investment could have supported the revived league.
However, insufficient support from players had already weakened plans to hold another LIV Golf season in 2027.
LIV Golf launched in 2022 and offered major guaranteed contracts to players.
Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, also known as PIF, provided money for the league.
However, PIF planned to stop financing LIV Golf after the end of the 2026 season.
The league filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in September.
This process gave LIV Golf a way to deal with its financial problems through the court.
The later withdrawal of the proposed investment and the lack of enough player support made plans for LIV 2.0 weaker.
Creditors and the remaining assets of LIV Golf will now proceed through bankruptcy proceedings.
These proceedings will handle the money and property that remain as the league winds down.
The New Jersey court process will therefore continue even though plans for a revived league have been abandoned.

articles.title: AI stocks stopped a worldwide market sell-off.
p: AI stocks helped stop a worldwide market sell-off on November 6, 2026.
U.S. technology shares recovered some of the losses they had made earlier in the week.
However, uncertainty about the future of artificial intelligence investment continued to affect trading.
The Nasdaq had fallen by as much as 5.3% on Thursday.
The decline came after Democratic victories in the U.S. midterm elections.
The sell-off affected major technology companies as well as semiconductor firms, which produce important parts used in computers and other electronic products.
Investors were also worried about the high valuations of AI companies.
A valuation is an estimate of how much a company is worth.
Some investors questioned whether these companies were worth their high market prices.
They also had concerns about the large amounts of money that AI businesses planned to spend.
On Friday, some AI-related shares improved.
Micron Technology shares rose 5.1% during trading.
This increase helped technology markets recover part of their weekly losses, but it did not remove all concerns about the sector.
Trading continued as investors reassessed the outlook for AI companies and their investment plans.
The recovery showed that buyers were still interested in technology shares.
Still, market uncertainty remained focused on AI investment, and further volatility was possible in technology markets.
